visual_action: An older, bald man with glasses speaks from a podium at what appears to be a political convention. The video cuts to wide shots of a large, enthusiastic crowd in an arena. The crowd members are on their feet, holding up red and black signs that read 'UNION YES!' and chanting.

cast.name: unnamed speaker
cast.evidence: An unidentified man is shown at a podium, smiling and leading a chant with the crowd.

cast.name: Democratic National Committee
cast.evidence: The on-screen text overlay states the event is taking place 'at the DNC'.

on_screen_text.text: Crowd erupts in chants of UNION YES! at the DNC 🔥

spoken_summary: An unnamed speaker and a large crowd chant 'Union yes!' repeatedly and enthusiastically. The speaker eventually says 'All right!' as the chanting continues.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of diegetic sound from the event: a loud, energetic crowd chanting 'Union yes!' in unison, along with the speaker's voice leading and joining the chant. There is no musical score. The effect is one of enthusiastic solidarity.
editing_pacing: The video uses quick cuts, alternating between a medium shot of the speaker at the podium and various wide and medium shots of the chanting crowd.
central_claim: The Democratic party and its supporters at the DNC are enthusiastically and unitedly in favor of labor unions.
intended_effect: To energize viewers and demonstrate the Democratic party's strong, popular support for unions.
uncertainty_flags: Could not identify the man speaking at the podium.
